purpose: Primitive Library units that must be refused at load time: off-schema, or citing what the primitive library does not hold. Each base holds one broken unit and is loaded in front of the reference base.

cases.note: A state evolution rule outside the closed vocabulary (§4.3) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
An access geometry naming a runtime data structure (N8) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
The opaque type is gone: a value the primitive cannot type cannot be rejected — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
A window evolution must declare its span — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.

cases.match: axis 'attention.headz' is not in the primitive_library
cases.note: A shape citing an axis the primitive library does not hold — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
A parameter role with no precision rule — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
A guard on an argument the primitive never declares: a dead guard, the case found in attention.dense before this schema — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
A default the enum does not admit — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.

cases.match: effects.reads: 'keys' is not an input port
cases.note: An effect naming no port — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
The file name is the version; the two must agree (§8.2) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.

A precision role with a sensitivity outside the closed set is off the grammar; the fixture role is `state.kv_test`, a new identity — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
A primitive pinning a template version the template does not carry (§4.6) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
A primitive naming a template the models base does not hold — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.

cases.match: declares model id 'decoder_causal_yarn', the primitive says 'something_else'
cases.note: The template's model id and the primitive's disagree — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
A primitive reading an undeclared analysis fact: there is no context namespace; a span is an argument (§4.4) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.

An empty partition list is an omission, not a statement: a primitive says `none` when no graph split preserves meaning (§4.1) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.

cases.match: unit parameter 'expert_weights' is not a slot
cases.note: A sparsity unit naming a slot the primitive does not have (§4.5) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
Operations on parameters are derived, never declared (§4.1); a primitive declares only state and sequence corrections — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
There is no reference type: an argument is a scalar, an enum or a record (O9.4) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
Presence of a port is present_when, one authority (I2) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
A comparison on an optional argument without default outside a present test is undecidable (§4.3) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
One identity carried by two bases with different contents is a conflict, not a choice (V1).

cases.match: is not in the admissible set
cases.note: A precision role's default is admissible — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.

cases.match: policy names 'token', not an input port
cases.note: A sparsity policy names an argument or an input port of the primitive — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
A base carrying a template primitive declares where its templates live (§4.6) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.

cases.match: state 'conv'.w: a sequence.position axis under a window rule
cases.note: A state payload is declared per position (§4.3): the positions of a window are the evolution's span, not an axis of the payload — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.

A partition's granularity is an expression over the primitive's arguments, like a span: one over an undeclared argument is refused at load — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.

A parameter slot naming a shape axis `multiplicity`, the name of the storage axis a location resolver addresses (§3.4, finding 30) — the fixture unit is version 1.0.1, a new identity beside the reference's.
A domain on an enum argument — a domain constrains a number, not an enumeration; the schema admits it only on cardinality, real or physical (C.1).
A primitive invariant without its description — the text V8 prints must be there (schema).
An invariant reading an argument the primitive does not declare (V8's condition is a primitive condition, checked at load like every other).

cases.match: compares 'scale', which may be absent, outside a present test
cases.note: An invariant comparing an optional argument without a `present` guard — undecidable, refused at load (§4.3), not read as false.

cases.match: domain upper bound reads 'scale', which may be absent
cases.note: A domain bound naming an argument that may be absent — a bound must always resolve, so it names a required or defaulted argument (§4.6, R06).
